dedupe_keys.name: west and central africa burnt area rasters

description: West and Central Africa - Burnt Area Rasters is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Action Against Hunger ACF - Regional Office for West and Central Africa ROWCA. Monthly and annual burnt area 300m rasters are calculated from 2018 onwards. The source data is the Burnt Area (BA) product from COPERNICUS Land Monitoring Service v4 (300m resolution), reprocessed to extract bushfire occurrence statistics. The data used comes from the data generated by the COPERNICUS terrestrial service, the European Commission's Earth observation programme. Coverage: Benin, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Central African Republic, Chad, Côte d'Ivoire and 4 more. The portal files it under the publisher Action Against Hunger ACF - Regional Office for West and Central Africa ROWCA. Its tags are affected area, agriculture-livestock, environment, hazards and risk, sahel. It offers 8 resource(s) in GEOTIFF. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-IGO-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
